$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Azure Cost Management. One entry per console section that makes a backend claim (proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py). Pure navigation/static/local-preference sections (Overview, Diagnose and solve problems, Configuration, Preview features) carry no backend claim and are intentionally not listed here. level.nano = core/azure_cost_core.py in-process (Nano / dev_server, checked by this test without CAP_BASE). level.offline = the full appliance (providers/azure_services.py), which wires the SAME core/azure_cost_core.py module over its own ARM resource store.

azure.cost.change_scope.title: Change scope (subscription)
limitations: Vyomi simulates one subscription; there are no management groups or billing accounts to pick between.

azure.cost.cost_analysis.title: Cost analysis (query, grouping, filters)
limitations: Daily/Monthly granularity reports an even split of the month-to-date total rather than a true per-day usage history.

azure.cost.alert_rules.title: Alert rules (a budget's notification thresholds)
limitations: Read-only view derived from Budgets — real Azure lets you manage threshold rules from this page directly; here, edit the budget instead.

azure.cost.cost_alerts.title: Cost alerts (derived from budget thresholds, dismiss/reactivate)
limitations: Only budget-threshold alerts are modelled; Azure's anomaly-detection alerts are not generated.

azure.cost.exports.title: Exports (create, list, delete, run now)
limitations: "Run now" computes the real total over Vyomi's inventory but does not deliver a CSV file into a storage account container.

azure.cost.advisor_recommendations.title: Advisor recommendations (derived from real inventory)
limitations: Recommendations are the highest-cost real resources in your inventory, not Azure Advisor's own usage-pattern heuristics (idle %, burst history, …).

azure.cost.azure_subscriptions.title: Azure subscriptions (billing scope list)
limitations: Shows Vyomi's one simulated subscription; no billing account/agreement metadata.

azure.cost.cost_allocation.title: Cost allocation (resource-group cost splitting rules)
limitations: Rules split cost by resource group only — real Cost allocation can also key off tags; that finer dimension isn't modelled.

azure.cost.reservations_hybrid_benefit.title: Reservations + Hybrid Benefit (purchase a commitment, real utilization, license discount)
limitations: The "Purchase" checkout (payment method, term pricing calculator) is not modelled; a reservation order is created directly with a VM size and quantity instead.
Utilization compares the reserved VM size/quantity to real compute spend of the same size only — Azure's own usage-pattern heuristics are not reproduced.
Azure Hybrid Benefit is modelled as a flat ~20% discount on a VM's list price when its licenseType is set to Windows Server — real Azure's per-SKU license-cost breakdown isn't reproduced.

azure.cost.savings_plans.title: Savings plans (list, create, delete, real utilization)
limitations: The "Purchase" checkout (payment method, hourly commitment slider) is not modelled; a plan is created directly with a commitment amount instead.
Utilization compares the committed hourly amount to real compute spend only — Azure's own usage-pattern heuristics are not reproduced.

azure.cost.invoices.title: Invoices (billing documents)
limitations: Vyomi does not generate real billing/invoice documents.

azure.cost.payment_methods.title: Payment methods (card/billing profile management)
limitations: Capturing or storing real payment instruments is out of scope for a simulator.

azure.cost.new_support_request.title: New support request (file a Microsoft support ticket)
limitations: Vyomi does not file real Microsoft support tickets.
